{{Quote|Fresh juna berries for you this morning. Very sweet.|[[Jono Dunn]]|<ref name="Jedi Apprentice: The Mark of the Crown">''[[Jedi Apprentice: The Mark of the Crown]]''</ref>}}
'''Juna berries''' were edible berries that could be found on the [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Gala]]. They had a very sweet taste. When [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] and his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] went to Gala during a mission, they were served Juna berries in one of their meals.<ref name="Jedi Apprentice: The Mark of the Crown" />
